source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Πασιανός Επίσκοπος Βαρκελώνης της Ισπανίας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 390)», puts him in the fourth century at Barcelona in Catalonia, says he had been married and that God took his wife to himself, puts his consecration as bishop «περί το 363 μ.Χ.», and names the Arians and the Novatianists as the heresies he wrote against. It gives no hymn.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Πασιανός κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 390 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 390)», leaving the year of his birth a question mark.
